int minimum(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b
int maximum(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b
string color_name(int side_id)
    return if side_id == 0 then "W" else "B"
int multiplier(string kind)
    return if kind == "backgammon" then 3 elif kind == "gammon" then 2 else 1
int parsed_number(string word)
    if word == "" or (#word > 1 and word[0] == "0")
        return -1
    for: j < #word
        if not "0123456789".contains(word[j])
            return -1
    match int(word)
        int value
            return value
        error problem
            return -1
bool in_range(string word, int low, int high)
    value := parsed_number(word)
    return low <= value <= high
class Position()
    men := [array(26, fill = 0), array(26, fill = 0)]
Position standard_position()
    result := Position()
    for: side_id < 2
        result.men[side_id][24] = 2
        result.men[side_id][13] = 5
        result.men[side_id][8] = 3
        result.men[side_id][6] = 5
    return result
int pips(Position pos, int side_id)
    result := 0
    for: 1 <= point <= 25
        result += point * pos.men[side_id][point]
    return result
int keith(Position pos, int side_id)
    own := pos.men[side_id]
    result := pips(pos, side_id) + 2 * maximum(own[1] - 1, 0) + maximum(own[2] - 1, 0) + maximum(own[3] - 3, 0)
    for: 4 <= point <= 6
        if own[point] == 0
            result += 1
    return result
bool contact(Position pos)
    white := 0
    black := 25
    for: 1 <= point <= 25
        if pos.men[0][point] > 0
            white = point
        if pos.men[1][point] > 0
            black = 25 - point
    return white > black
class Evaluation(int value, int pip_delta, int blots, int home, int prime, int anchors, int bar_delta)
Evaluation evaluate(Position pos, int side_id)
    other := 1 - side_id
    own := pos.men[side_id]
    s := 0
    h := 0
    r := 0
    run := 0
    anchors_count := 0
    for: 1 <= point <= 24
        if own[point] >= 2
            run += 1
            r = maximum(r, run)
            if point <= 6
                h += 1
            if point >= 19
                anchors_count += 1
        else
            run = 0
        if own[point] == 1
            distances := array(25, fill = false)
            for: q < point
                if pos.men[other][25 - q] > 0
                    distances[point - q] = true
            for: 1 <= a <= 6
                for: 1 <= b <= 6
                    if distances[a] or distances[b] or distances[a + b] or (a == b and (distances[3 * a] or distances[4 * a]))
                        s += 1
    p := pips(pos, other) - pips(pos, side_id)
    g := pos.men[other][25] - own[25]
    return Evaluation(2 * p - s + 4 * h + 3 * r + 3 * anchors_count + 6 * g, p, s, h, r, anchors_count, g)
class Move(int source, int target)
Move[] sorted_moves(Move[] moves)
    for: 1 <= a < int(#moves)
        b := a
        while b > 0 and (moves[b].source > moves[b - 1].source or (moves[b].source == moves[b - 1].source and moves[b].target > moves[b - 1].target))
            temporary := moves[b]
            moves[b] = moves[b - 1]
            moves[b - 1] = temporary
            b -= 1
    return moves
T[] erase<T>(const T[] items, int at)
    T[] result := []
    for: j < #items
        if int(j) != at
            result = result.append(items[j])
    return result
class Play(Position final_position, Move[] key, bool[] hits, int used, int first_die)
    string notation()
        if #key == 0
            return "none"
        string[] parts := []
        printed_hit := array(26, fill = false)
        at := 0
        while at < int(#key)
            pair := key[at]
            count := 1
            while at + count < int(#key) and key[at + count] == pair
                count += 1
            source_text := if pair.source == 25 then "bar" else string(pair.source)
            target_text := if pair.target == 0 then "off" else string(pair.target)
            if hits[pair.target] and not printed_hit[pair.target]
                target_text += "*"
                printed_hit[pair.target] = true
            suffix := if count > 1 then "({count})" else ""
            parts = parts.append("{source_text}/{target_text}{suffix}")
            at += count
        return parts.join(" ")
Move[] canonical_key(Move[] sequence, bool[] hits)
    result := sorted_moves(sequence)
    while true
        first := -1
        second := -1
        for: j < #result
            destination := result[j].target
            if destination == 0 or hits[destination]
                continue
            for: k < #result
                if result[k].source == destination
                    first = int(j)
                    second = int(k)
                    break
            if first >= 0
                break
        if first < 0
            return result
        merged := Move(result[first].source, result[second].target)
        result = erase(result, maximum(first, second))
        result = erase(result, minimum(first, second))
        result = sorted_moves(result.append(merged))
bool before(Play left, Play right)
    for: j < minimum(int(#left.key), int(#right.key))
        if left.key[j].source != right.key[j].source
            return left.key[j].source > right.key[j].source
        if left.key[j].target != right.key[j].target
            return left.key[j].target > right.key[j].target
    return #left.key > #right.key
Play[] enumerate_plays(Position pos, int side_id, int[] remaining, Move[] sequence, bool[] hits, int first_die)
    result := [Play(pos, canonical_key(sequence, hits), hits, int(#sequence), first_die)]
    own := pos.men[side_id]
    home_only := true
    for: 7 <= point <= 25
        if own[point] > 0
            home_only = false
    for: 1 <= die <= 6
        if remaining[die] == 0
            continue
        for: 25 >= source >= 1 step -1
            if own[source] == 0 or (own[25] > 0 and source != 25)
                continue
            target := source - die
            if target > 0
                if pos.men[1 - side_id][25 - target] >= 2
                    continue
            else
                if not home_only
                    continue
                farther := false
                for: source + 1 <= point <= 6
                    if own[point] > 0
                        farther = true
                if target < 0 and farther
                    continue
                target = 0
            next_pos := pos
            next_hits := hits
            next_pos.men[side_id][source] -= 1
            next_pos.men[side_id][target] += 1
            if target > 0 and next_pos.men[1 - side_id][25 - target] == 1
                next_pos.men[1 - side_id][25 - target] = 0
                next_pos.men[1 - side_id][25] += 1
                next_hits[target] = true
            next_remaining := remaining
            next_remaining[die] -= 1
            result = result.concat(enumerate_plays(next_pos, side_id, next_remaining, sequence.append(Move(source, target)), next_hits, if #sequence == 0 then die else first_die))
    return result
class Generated(Play[] possible, Play[] legal, int maximum_used)
Generated generate(Position pos, int side_id, int d1, int d2)
    remaining := array(7, fill = 0)
    remaining[d1] += if d1 == d2 then 4 else 1
    if d1 != d2
        remaining[d2] += 1
    possible := enumerate_plays(pos, side_id, remaining, [], array(26, fill = false), 0)
    maximum_used := 0
    larger := false
    for play := possible[]
        maximum_used = maximum(maximum_used, play.used)
        larger = larger or (play.used == 1 and play.first_die == maximum(d1, d2))
    Play[] legal := []
    for play := possible[]
        if play.used != maximum_used or (maximum_used == 1 and d1 != d2 and larger and play.first_die != maximum(d1, d2))
            continue
        duplicate := false
        for prior := legal[]
            if prior.final_position == play.final_position
                duplicate = true
        if not duplicate
            legal = legal.append(play)
    for: 1 <= a < int(#legal)
        b := a
        while b > 0 and before(legal[b], legal[b - 1])
            temporary := legal[b]
            legal[b] = legal[b - 1]
            legal[b - 1] = temporary
            b -= 1
    return Generated(possible, legal, maximum_used)
int best_play(Play[] plays, int side_id)
    chosen := 0
    best_value := evaluate(plays[0].final_position, side_id).value
    for: 1 <= j < #plays
        candidate := evaluate(plays[j].final_position, side_id).value
        if candidate > best_value
            chosen = int(j)
            best_value = candidate
    return chosen
class State()
    pos := standard_position()
    side_id := 0
    cube := 1
    owner := -1
    pending := false
    over := false
    score := [0, 0]
    winner := -1
    kind := ""
    points := 0
    string owner_text()
        return if owner < 0 then "center" else color_name(owner)
    string cube_decision(prohibited := false)
        if owner == 1 - side_id or cube == 64 or prohibited
            return "unavailable"
        if contact(pos)
            value := evaluate(pos, side_id).value
            return if value < 60 then "no double" elif value <= 100 then "double take" else "double drop"
        value := 8 * keith(pos, side_id) - 7 * keith(pos, 1 - side_id)
        limit := if owner < 0 then 28 else 21
        return if value > limit then "no double" elif value >= 14 then "double take" else "double drop"
    void .finish(int winning_side, string result_kind)
        over = true
        pending = false
        winner = winning_side
        kind = result_kind
        points = multiplier(result_kind) * cube
        score[winning_side] += points
    void .apply_play(Play play)
        pos = play.final_position
        if pos.men[side_id][0] == 15
            other := 1 - side_id
            result_kind := "single"
            if pos.men[other][0] == 0
                result_kind = "gammon"
                backgammon := pos.men[other][25] > 0
                for: 19 <= point <= 24
                    backgammon = backgammon or pos.men[other][point] > 0
                if backgammon
                    result_kind = "backgammon"
            .finish(side_id, result_kind)
        else
            side_id = 1 - side_id
    string result_line()
        return "result {color_name(winner)} {kind} {points}"
class Random(int seed)
    int .next_value()
        seed = (48271 * seed) % 2147483647
        return seed
    int .die()
        return .next_value() % 6 + 1
class GameResult(State state_value, int first_player, int turns, string[] lines)
GameResult simulate(State start_state, string[] strategies, Random &generator, bool opening, match_limit := 0, match_scores := [0, 0], crawford := false, verbose := false)
    current := start_state
    d1 := 0
    d2 := 0
    if opening
        while d1 == d2
            d1 = .generator.die()
            d2 = .generator.die()
        current.side_id = if d1 > d2 then 0 else 1
    first_player := current.side_id
    turn_number := 1
    plays_made := 0
    string[] lines := []
    while not current.over
        side_id := current.side_id
        other := 1 - side_id
        if not (opening and turn_number == 1)
            prohibited := crawford or (match_limit > 0 and match_scores[side_id] + current.cube >= match_limit)
            decision := current.cube_decision(prohibited)
            if decision == "double take" or decision == "double drop"
                if verbose
                    lines = lines.append("{turn_number} {color_name(side_id)} doubles {current.cube * 2}").append("{turn_number} {color_name(other)} " + (if decision == "double take" then "takes" else "drops"))
                if decision == "double drop"
                    .current.finish(side_id, "drop")
                    break
                current.cube *= 2
                current.owner = other
            d1 = .generator.die()
            d2 = .generator.die()
        plays := generate(current.pos, side_id, d1, d2).legal
        strategy := strategies[side_id]
        choice := if strategy == "BEST" then best_play(plays, side_id) elif strategy == "RANDOM" then .generator.next_value() % int(#plays) else 0
        if verbose
            lines = lines.append("{turn_number} {color_name(side_id)} {d1}-{d2} {plays[choice].notation()}")
        .current.apply_play(plays[choice])
        plays_made += 1
        turn_number += 1
    if verbose
        lines = lines.append(current.result_line())
    return GameResult(current, first_player, plays_made, lines)
Move[] | error parse_play(string[] elements)
    if #elements == 1 and elements[0] == "none"
        return []
    Move[] result := []
    for element := elements[]
        copies := 1
        if element.ends_with(")")
            size := int(#element)
            if size < 3 or element[size - 3] != "(" or not "234".contains(element[size - 2])
                return error("syntax")
            copies = parsed_number(element[size - 2])
            element = element[0:<size - 3]
        if element.contains("(") or element.contains(")")
            return error("syntax")
        parts := element.split("/")
        if #parts < 2
            return error("syntax")
        source := if parts[0] == "bar" then 25 else parsed_number(parts[0])
        if not (1 <= source <= 25) or (source == 25 and parts[0] != "bar")
            return error("syntax")
        for: 1 <= j < #parts
            part := parts[j]
            if part.ends_with("*")
                part = part[0:<int(#part) - 1]
                if part == "off"
                    return error("syntax")
            target := if part == "off" then 0 else parsed_number(part)
            if not (0 <= target <= 24) or (target == 0 and part != "off") or target >= source
                return error("syntax")
            for: k < copies
                result = result.append(Move(source, target))
            source = target
    return result
class HistoryEntry(string record_text, State before_state, State after_state)
class Referee()
    state_value := State()
    HistoryEntry[] history := []
    HistoryEntry[] redo_list := []
    string[] .make_play(Play play, int d1, int d2, string response)
        State old_state := state_value
        record_text := "{color_name(state_value.side_id)} {d1}-{d2} {play.notation()}"
        .state_value.apply_play(play)
        history = history.append(HistoryEntry(record_text, old_state, state_value))
        redo_list = []
        return if state_value.over then [response, state_value.result_line()] else [response]
    string board_row(bool upper, int row)
        result := ""
        for: j < 12
            point := if upper then 13 + j else 12 - j
            if j == 6
                result += " |"
            cell := string(point)
            if row > 0
                int white := state_value.pos.men[0][point]
                int black := state_value.pos.men[1][25 - point]
                count := maximum(white, black)
                cell = if count < row then "." elif row == 5 and count > 5 then string(count) elif white > 0 then "W" else "B"
            result += " " * nat(3 - int(#cell)) + cell
        return result
    string[] .command(string[] words)
        op := words[0]
        no_args := ["NEW", "SHOW", "BOARD", "PIPS", "RACE", "EVAL", "SHOTS", "CUBE", "DOUBLE", "TAKE", "DROP", "SCORE", "HISTORY"]
        known := false
        valid := false
        for candidate := no_args[]
            if candidate == op
                known = true
                valid = #words == 1
        if op == "POS"
            if #words != 5
                return ["ERROR bad position"]
            points := words[1].split(",")
            if #points != 24 or not in_range(words[2], 0, 15) or not in_range(words[3], 0, 15) or (words[4] != "W" and words[4] != "B")
                return ["ERROR bad position"]
            next_state := State()
            next_state.pos = Position()
            next_state.score = state_value.score
            next_state.side_id = if words[4] == "W" then 0 else 1
            totals := [parsed_number(words[2]), parsed_number(words[3])]
            next_state.pos.men[0][25] = totals[0]
            next_state.pos.men[1][25] = totals[1]
            for: j < #points
                value := int(points[j])
                if value > 0
                    next_state.pos.men[0][j + 1] = value
                    totals[0] += value
                elif value < 0
                    next_state.pos.men[1][24 - int(j)] = -value
                    totals[1] -= value
            if not (1 <= totals[0] <= 15) or not (1 <= totals[1] <= 15)
                return ["ERROR bad position"]
            next_state.pos.men[0][0] = 15 - totals[0]
            next_state.pos.men[1][0] = 15 - totals[1]
            state_value = next_state
            history = []
            redo_list = []
            return ["OK"]
        if op == "MOVES" or op == "PLAY" or op == "AUTO" or op == "HINT"
            known = true
            valid = (if op == "PLAY" then #words >= 4 elif op == "HINT" then #words == 4 else #words == 3)
            if valid
                valid = in_range(words[1], 1, 6) and in_range(words[2], 1, 6) and (op != "HINT" or in_range(words[3], 1, 1000))
        elif op == "UNDO" or op == "REDO"
            known = true
            valid = #words == 2 and in_range(words[1], 1, 1000)
        elif op == "RESIGN"
            known = true
            valid = #words == 2 and (words[1] == "single" or words[1] == "gammon" or words[1] == "backgammon")
        elif op == "GAME"
            known = true
            valid = #words == 4
            if valid
                valid = in_range(words[1], 1, 2147483646)
                for: 2 <= j <= 3
                    valid = valid and (words[j] == "BEST" or words[j] == "FIRST" or words[j] == "RANDOM")
        elif op == "MATCH" or op == "STATS"
            known = true
            valid = #words == 3 and in_range(words[1], 1, if op == "MATCH" then 15 else 50) and in_range(words[2], 1, 2147483646)
        if not known
            return ["ERROR unknown command"]
        if not valid
            return ["ERROR bad arguments"]
        disallow_over := op == "RACE" or op == "MOVES" or op == "PLAY" or op == "AUTO" or op == "HINT" or op == "EVAL" or op == "SHOTS" or op == "CUBE" or op == "DOUBLE" or op == "TAKE" or op == "DROP" or op == "RESIGN" or op == "GAME"
        if disallow_over and state_value.over
            return ["ERROR game over"]
        disallow_pending := op == "PLAY" or op == "AUTO" or op == "CUBE" or op == "DOUBLE" or op == "RESIGN" or op == "GAME"
        if disallow_pending and state_value.pending
            return ["ERROR double pending"]
        int side_id := state_value.side_id
        Position pos := state_value.pos
        if op == "NEW"
            int[] old_score := state_value.score
            state_value = State()
            state_value.score = old_score
            history = []
            redo_list = []
            return ["OK"]
        if op == "SHOW"
            string[] points := []
            for: 1 <= point <= 24
                points = points.append(string(pos.men[0][point] - pos.men[1][25 - point]))
            return ["POS " + points.join(",") + " {pos.men[0][25]} {pos.men[1][25]} {color_name(side_id)}"]
        if op == "BOARD"
            string[] output := [board_row(true, 0)]
            for: 1 <= row <= 5
                output = output.append(board_row(true, row))
            status := if state_value.over then "game over" elif state_value.pending then "{color_name(side_id)} doubles" else "{color_name(side_id)} to move"
            output = output.append("bar W{pos.men[0][25]} B{pos.men[1][25]} | off W{pos.men[0][0]} B{pos.men[1][0]} | cube {state_value.cube} {state_value.owner_text()} | {status}")
            for: 5 >= row >= 1 step -1
                output = output.append(board_row(false, row))
            return output.append(board_row(false, 0))
        if op == "PIPS"
            return ["pips W {pips(pos, 0)} B {pips(pos, 1)}"]
        if op == "RACE"
            return [if contact(pos) then "contact" else "race W {keith(pos, 0)} B {keith(pos, 1)}"]
        if op == "EVAL"
            ev := evaluate(pos, side_id)
            return ["eval {ev.value} pips {ev.pip_delta} blots {ev.blots} home {ev.home} prime {ev.prime} anchors {ev.anchors} bar {ev.bar_delta}"]
        if op == "CUBE"
            return ["cube " + state_value.cube_decision()]
        if op == "SCORE"
            return ["score W {state_value.score[0]} B {state_value.score[1]}"]
        if op == "HISTORY"
            output := ["history {#history}"]
            for: j < #history
                output = output.append("{j + 1} {history[j].record_text}")
            return output
        if op == "UNDO" or op == "REDO"
            count := parsed_number(words[1])
            if op == "UNDO"
                if count > int(#history)
                    return ["ERROR cannot undo"]
                at := int(#history) - count
                state_value = history[at].before_state
                redo_list = history[at:].concat(redo_list)
                history = history[0:<at]
            else
                if count > int(#redo_list)
                    return ["ERROR cannot redo"]
                state_value = redo_list[count - 1].after_state
                history = history.concat(redo_list[0:<count])
                redo_list = redo_list[count:]
            return ["OK"]
        if op == "DOUBLE"
            if state_value.owner == 1 - side_id or state_value.cube == 64
                return ["ERROR cube unavailable"]
            state_value.pending = true
            redo_list = []
            return ["OK double {state_value.cube * 2}"]
        if op == "TAKE" or op == "DROP"
            if not state_value.pending
                return ["ERROR no double"]
            state_value.pending = false
            redo_list = []
            if op == "TAKE"
                state_value.cube *= 2
                state_value.owner = 1 - side_id
                return ["OK take {state_value.cube} {state_value.owner_text()}"]
            .state_value.finish(side_id, "drop")
            return ["OK drop", state_value.result_line()]
        if op == "RESIGN"
            .state_value.finish(1 - side_id, words[1])
            redo_list = []
            return ["OK resign", state_value.result_line()]
        if op == "GAME"
            generator := Random(parsed_number(words[1]))
            return simulate(state_value, [words[2], words[3]], &generator, false, verbose = true).lines
        if op == "MATCH" or op == "STATS"
            count := parsed_number(words[1])
            generator := Random(parsed_number(words[2]))
            scores := [0, 0]
            int[][] wins := [[0, 0], [0, 0], [0, 0], [0, 0]]
            kinds := ["single", "gammon", "backgammon", "drop"]
            total_turns := 0
            game_number := 0
            crawford_used := false
            string[] output := []
            while (op == "STATS" and game_number < count) or (op == "MATCH" and maximum(scores[0], scores[1]) < count)
                crawford := op == "MATCH" and not crawford_used and maximum(scores[0], scores[1]) == count - 1
                crawford_used = crawford_used or crawford
                result := simulate(State(), ["BEST", "BEST"], &generator, true, if op == "MATCH" then count else 0, scores, crawford)
                ended := result.state_value
                scores[ended.winner] += ended.points
                total_turns += result.turns
                game_number += 1
                for: j < #kinds
                    if kinds[j] == ended.kind
                        wins[j][ended.winner] += 1
                if op == "MATCH"
                    label := if crawford then " crawford" else ""
                    output = output.append("game {game_number}{label} start {color_name(result.first_player)} turns {result.turns} {ended.result_line()} score {scores[0]}-{scores[1]}")
            if op == "MATCH"
                winner := if scores[0] >= count then 0 else 1
                return output.append("match {color_name(winner)} {scores[0]}-{scores[1]}")
            for: j < #kinds
                output = output.append("{kinds[j]} W {wins[j][0]} B {wins[j][1]}")
            return output.append("points W {scores[0]} B {scores[1]}").append("turns {total_turns}")
        if op == "SHOTS"
            counts := array(26, fill = 0)
            total := 0
            rolls := ""
            for: 6 >= a >= 1 step -1
                for: a >= b >= 1 step -1
                    hit_points := array(26, fill = false)
                    for play := generate(pos, 1 - side_id, a, b).legal[]
                        for: 1 <= point <= 24
                            if play.hits[point]
                                hit_points[25 - point] = true
                    any_hit := false
                    weight := if a == b then 1 else 2
                    for: 1 <= point <= 24
                        if pos.men[side_id][point] == 1 and hit_points[point]
                            counts[point] += weight
                            any_hit = true
                    if any_hit
                        total += weight
                        rolls += " {a}-{b}"
            output := ["shots {total}/36{rolls}"]
            for: 24 >= point >= 1 step -1
                if pos.men[side_id][point] == 1
                    output = output.append("blot {point} {counts[point]}/36")
            return output
        d1 := parsed_number(words[1])
        d2 := parsed_number(words[2])
        generated := generate(pos, side_id, d1, d2)
        if op == "MOVES"
            string[] output := []
            for play := generated.legal[]
                output = output.append(play.notation())
            return output.append("total {#generated.legal}")
        if op == "HINT"
            Play[] ranked := generated.legal
            for: 1 <= a < int(#ranked)
                b := a
                while b > 0 and evaluate(ranked[b].final_position, side_id).value > evaluate(ranked[b - 1].final_position, side_id).value
                    temporary := ranked[b]
                    ranked[b] = ranked[b - 1]
                    ranked[b - 1] = temporary
                    b -= 1
            string[] output := []
            for: int j < minimum(parsed_number(words[3]), int(#ranked))
                output = output.append("{evaluate(ranked[j].final_position, side_id).value} {ranked[j].notation()}")
            return output
        if op == "AUTO"
            chosen := generated.legal[best_play(generated.legal, side_id)]
            return .make_play(chosen, d1, d2, "OK {chosen.notation()} eval {evaluate(chosen.final_position, side_id).value}")
        Move[] moves
        match parse_play(words[3:])
            Move[] parsed
                moves = parsed
            error problem
                return ["ILLEGAL syntax"]
        final_position := pos
        destinations := array(26, fill = false)
        nonbar := false
        bearing := false
        blocked := false
        for pair := moves[]
            final_position.men[side_id][pair.source] -= 1
            final_position.men[side_id][pair.target] += 1
            destinations[pair.target] = true
            nonbar = nonbar or pair.source != 25
            bearing = bearing or pair.target == 0
            blocked = blocked or (pair.target > 0 and pos.men[1 - side_id][25 - pair.target] >= 2)
        for: 1 <= point <= 24
            if destinations[point] and pos.men[1 - side_id][25 - point] == 1
                final_position.men[1 - side_id][25 - point] = 0
                final_position.men[1 - side_id][25] += 1
        for: 1 <= point <= 25
            if final_position.men[side_id][point] < 0
                return ["ILLEGAL no checker"]
        if final_position.men[side_id][25] > 0 and nonbar
            return ["ILLEGAL bar"]
        if blocked
            return ["ILLEGAL blocked"]
        if bearing
            for: 7 <= point <= 25
                if final_position.men[side_id][point] > 0
                    return ["ILLEGAL bear-off"]
        for play := generated.legal[]
            if play.final_position == final_position
                return .make_play(play, d1, d2, "OK " + play.notation())
        possible := false
        too_few := false
        for play := generated.possible[]
            if play.final_position == final_position
                possible = true
                too_few = too_few or play.used < generated.maximum_used
        return [if too_few then "ILLEGAL too few dice" elif possible then "ILLEGAL larger die required" else "ILLEGAL impossible"]
